$comment: Maps internal Salesforce values to customer-safe stages. internal_value entries are PLACEHOLDERS — populate from config/salesforce-field-map.generated.json picklists; wording requires compliance approval before activation. verification_level: 0=none, 1=phone+confirmation, 2=secure verification.

stages.customer_wording: We've received your inquiry and are getting things started.
stages.next_step: We'll ask a few quick questions to point you in the right direction.

stages.customer_wording: Our team has your inquiry and is in touch.
stages.next_step: Reply here with any questions, or ask for a call.

stages.customer_wording: We're gathering a few basics about your business.
stages.next_step: Answering the remaining questions helps us match you with options.

stages.customer_wording: Your application hasn't been started yet.
stages.next_step: We can send your secure application link whenever you're ready.

stages.customer_wording: We've sent your secure application link.
stages.next_step: Complete the application at the link; reply here if you hit any issues.

stages.customer_wording: Your application is in progress.
stages.next_step: Finish the remaining application steps at your secure link.

stages.customer_wording: We've received your application.
stages.next_step: Our team is reviewing it; we'll reach out if anything else is needed.

stages.customer_wording: A few documents are still needed to move forward.
stages.next_step: Please upload them through your secure application portal.

stages.customer_wording: We've received your documents.
stages.next_step: They're with our review team now.

stages.customer_wording: Your documents are under review.
stages.next_step: We'll update you as soon as review completes.

stages.customer_wording: Your file is in review with our team.
stages.next_step: No action needed right now; we'll reach out with the outcome or any questions.

stages.customer_wording: Your specialist has options to discuss with you.
stages.next_step: Would you like us to set up a call?

stages.customer_wording: An offer is being reviewed with you.
stages.next_step: Your specialist will walk you through the details.

stages.customer_wording: Contracts have been sent to you.
stages.next_step: Review and sign at the secure link your specialist provided.

stages.customer_wording: We've received your signed contracts.
stages.next_step: Final steps are in motion; your specialist will confirm timing.

stages.customer_wording: Funding is in the final stage.
stages.next_step: Your specialist will confirm the details directly.

stages.customer_wording: Your file shows as funded.
stages.next_step: Reply here if you need anything else — we're happy to help.

stages.customer_wording: We have your info and will follow up at the time you asked.
stages.next_step: Reply any time if you'd like to pick things back up sooner.

stages.customer_wording: Your file isn't moving forward at this time.
stages.next_step: A specialist can discuss details or future options with you.

stages.customer_wording: A member of our team is handling your conversation.
stages.next_step: They'll reply here directly.

stages.customer_wording: This file is closed.
stages.next_step: Reply here or ask for a call if you'd like to start a new request.
